title: 92 Corrib Road, Dublin 6w, Kimmage, Dublin 6w, D6WK447

description:
Doran Estates are delighted to present No. 92 Corrib Road to the market – a charming three-bedroom home with a truly impressive rear garden, ideally positioned within this quiet and highly sought-after enclave in the heart of Terenure, Dublin 6W.
This well-located property offers a fantastic opportunity for the new owner to refresh and personalise a home in one of Dublin’s most desirable residential areas. With generous accommodation, off-street parking and a stunning rear garden extending to approximately 150 sq.m. (1,600 sq.ft.), No. 92 Corrib Road provides excellent potential in a mature and peaceful setting.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming porch and entrance hall, a bright living room positioned to the front of the property with feature fireplace and double doors opening into the adjoining sitting/dining room. The kitchen is located to the rear with direct access to the exceptional garden, while a bathroom and guest WC complete the ground floor.
Upstairs, the property offers three bedrooms, including two spacious double bedrooms and a single bedroom, providing comfortable and versatile living accommodation.
Externally, the property benefits from off-street parking to the front, with a shared side entrance leading to the outstanding rear garden. The garden is a particular highlight of the property, offering a generous outdoor space with excellent potential for landscaping, entertaining or simply enjoying the tranquillity of this wonderful location.

Corrib Road is a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking a circular green area, creating a peaceful residential setting while remaining within easy reach of local amenities. The property is ideally located close to Terenure village and Harold’s Cross, with an excellent selection of shops, cafés, schools, churches, sporting facilities and recreational amenities nearby. Bushy Park is also within easy reach, while the location provides convenient access to Dublin City Centre, the M50 and excellent public transport links.

No. 92 Corrib Road represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a property with outstanding potential in a prime Dublin 6W location. Early viewing is highly recommended.
